name: mirage
text: Findings so far, no code changed yet. (1) PropLine IS streaming right now: engine log 17:55 UTC says board live (last frame 0 s ago), signals live, 1 connection, median delay about 3 s, 321 book boards on its heartbeat. The earlier 'off' line was only from engine start-up (17:29), and the old connection-cap problem (11 conns vs cap 2) is gone. (2) ParlayAPI is reaching the engine too (40 books healthy, sockets live) and it does win lines where its quote is newer, mainly Pinnacle and props (about 7,700 Pinnacle prices from its props feed, 5,500 from its game feed in the last census). It does not show on your screenshot because PropLine's copy was equal or newer for those books. (3) What I have not explained: your screenshot still shows 7-10 min ages on PropLine rows even with its stream live. The stream only marks a quote current for books on its heartbeat, so a game or market the heartbeat does not cover keeps the book's own old stamp. I am now finding which markets those are (probably far-off games) and will make them read as fresh when they are confirmed current, or let ParlayAPI take them. I will tell you what I changed.
